estimates.name: Goodwill
estimates.t: Goodwill represents the excess of the purchase price over the estimated fair value of the net tangible and identifiable intangible assets acquired in business combinations.
estimates.effect: Because the carrying amount exceeded estimated fair value, we recognized a non‑cash goodwill impairment charge of $272.4 million for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, fully impairing our remaining goodwill balance to zero.
